description: Savor the comforting embrace of Lebanese Rishta Lentil Noodles, a beloved Middle Eastern pasta dish that warms the soul. This rustic and hearty meal combines tender lentils with delicate flat noodles, all infused with fragrant garlic, cilantro, and a bright lemon finish. Topped with crispy fried onions, it offers a delightful contrast of textures and flavors in every spoonful.

ingredients.item: Small flat pasta (tagliatelle or egg noodles)

instructions.title: Cook the Lentils
instructions.text: Rinse the brown or green lentils thoroughly. In a large pot, combine the rinsed lentils with 4 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender but still hold their shape. Do not overcook.

instructions.title: Prepare the Fried Onions
instructions.text: While lentils cook, heat about 1/4 cup of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add two of the thinly sliced onions and fry, stirring occasionally, until deeply golden brown and crispy. This will take about 10-15 minutes. Remove crispy onions with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain. Set aside for garnish.

instructions.title: Sauté Aromatics
instructions.text: In the same skillet with the remaining oil (add a little more if needed), add the remaining sliced onion. Sauté over medium heat until softened and translucent, about 5-7 minutes. Add the minced garlic and chopped cilantro to the skillet and cook for another 2-3 minutes until fragrant.

instructions.title: Combine and Simmer
instructions.text: Add the sautéed onion, garlic, and cilantro mixture to the pot with the cooked lentils and their cooking liquid. If the liquid has reduced significantly, add the remaining 2 cups of water or vegetable broth. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.

instructions.title: Add the Pasta
instructions.text: Add the broken flat pasta to the simmering lentil mixture. Stir well to prevent sticking. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 8-10 minutes, or until the pasta is al dente and cooked through. The dish should have a stew-like consistency; add a splash more water if it becomes too thick.

instructions.title: Season and Finish
instructions.text: Remove the pot from the heat. Stir in the fresh lemon juice, salt, and black pepper. Taste and adjust seasonings as needed. The lemon juice adds a crucial bright and tangy flavor.

instructions.title: Serve
instructions.text: Ladle the hot Rishta Lentil Noodles into bowls. Garnish generously with the crispy fried onions you prepared earlier. Serve immediately, perhaps with a side of fresh salad or pickled vegetables.

tips: For truly authentic flavor, consider making fresh flat pasta (rishta) from scratch, though good quality dried egg noodles work wonderfully.
Do not overcook the lentils; they should be tender but still have a slight bite to prevent them from becoming mushy in the stew.
Serve Rishta Lentil Noodles hot, garnished with a generous amount of crispy fried onions and a drizzle of fresh olive oil for an extra layer of richness.
